acceptance_criteria: Both the recorded-input and braking-box rollouts complete at the fixed 0.01 s horizon with model.gvs@1.0.0 and 0.002 s implicit-Euler steps, returning endpoint tip speed and position without solver error at the update-33 saved state.

The endpoint tip speed difference (recorded input minus braking box) is reported with units and is compared against the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit; the endpoint tip position difference is compared against the 0.01 m settling position limit.
The result is reported strictly as a bounded local single-state, single-horizon comparison and is not extended to closed-loop settling or a dominant cause.
discriminating_observations: Whether the recorded-input endpoint tip speed lies markedly above versus near the braking-box endpoint tip speed at the same state, input magnitude context, and 0.01 s horizon.
The magnitude of the recorded-minus-braking endpoint tip speed difference and whether the recorded endpoint speed is far above 0.02 m/s.
Whether the recorded-minus-braking endpoint tip position difference is small relative to the 0.01 m position limit (little local steering difference despite a speed difference).
fixed_conditions: Model model.gvs@1.0.0, implicit Euler, fixed integration step 0.002 s, fixed short horizon 0.01 s.
Saved projected measured_initial_state of update 33 and its recorded applied tension (actual_tension_n) held fixed; the comparison swaps only the input, not the state.
No control-parameter adoption; project remains proposal_compliant_build with the frozen configuration artifact; no backend execution and no closed-loop replay.
Exactly one saved-state check at one state, within max_checks 1 and max_wall_s 300.
hypotheses: The recorded applied tension at this sampled late state already commands near-maximal braking, so its 0.01 s endpoint tip speed is close to the braking-box endpoint and the residual late tip speed is not explained by a non-braking command at this state.
The recorded applied tension leaves a 0.01 s endpoint tip speed well above the instantaneous braking-box endpoint, i.e. the applied command under-brakes at this high-speed late state.
arguments.local_question: At the saved projected measured_initial_state of controller update 33 (start t=0.33 s, inside the 0.05 s settling window, the highest late-window tip speed, 1.5810152739742807 m/s), does the recorded applied tension (actual_tension_n) produce a 0.01 s endpoint tip speed/position that differs from an instantaneous braking-box input at the same state and previous input, and by how much?
metrics: Endpoint tip speed at the fixed 0.01 s horizon for the recorded input and for the instantaneous braking-box input, m/s.
Endpoint tip position (and tip error) at the fixed 0.01 s horizon for the recorded input and for the braking-box input, m.
Recorded-minus-braking endpoint tip speed difference, m/s.
Recorded-minus-braking endpoint tip position difference, m.
Comparison of the recorded-input endpoint tip speed against the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit.
